note: B2 WF TEMPLATE, James dropdowns 2026-09-05. FCE cloze house style cloned from b1_suffixes. Tranche A above b1_prefixes' core 8 (un/dis/in-family/re/pre/over/under/mis): inter- / trans- / non- / anti- / co- / sub- / ex-. Every ROOT checked taught in the position pool before entry (view/personal/social/operate/organisation/politics were missing and are excluded). C57 recap card of Prefixes 1. Common-mistakes rows are real L1 traps: Czech antivir, titulky->titles, under/sub confusion.

cards.title: Prefixes 2
points: This set builds **relations** — between, across, against, together, below, former.

cards.title: You already know
points: Prefixes 1 gave you the **core eight** — all about *not*, *again* and *too much*.
They still work here. Today's prefixes add **relations**, not negatives.

cards.title: Between and across
points: **inter-** joins two sides: inter + national = between nations.
**trans-** crosses or changes: trans + form = change the form.

cards.title: No, against, and former
points: **non-** = not at all. **anti-** = against. **ex-** = it ended.
**ex-** takes a hyphen and a person or role: **ex-wife**, **ex-president**.

cards.title: Together and below
points: **co-** shares the job: a co-pilot flies **with** the pilot.
**sub-** sits below: a subway runs **under** the way.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: Czech shortcuts do not work in English — build the full word.

items.en: inter-
items.cz: mezi · between

items.en: trans-
items.cz: přes, na jinou formu · across

items.en: non-
items.cz: ne-, vůbec · not at all

items.en: anti-
items.cz: proti · against

items.en: co-
items.cz: spolu- · together

items.en: sub-
items.cz: pod- · under

items.en: ex-
items.cz: bývalý · former

items.en: The company works with international customers every day.
items.cz: Ta firma denně pracuje s mezinárodními zákazníky.
items.gap: The company works with ____ customers every day. (NATIONAL)
accepts: The company works with international customers every day.
items.explanation: **inter-** = between: inter + national = between nations.
items.explanation_cz: **inter-** = mezi: inter + national = mezi národy.

items.en: The museum has an interactive map for children.
items.cz: To muzeum má pro děti interaktivní mapu.
items.gap: The museum has an ____ map for children. (ACTIVE)
accepts: The museum has an interactive map for children.
items.explanation: **inter-** + active — the map and the child act on each other.
items.explanation_cz: **inter-** + active — mapa a dítě na sebe navzájem působí.

items.en: The new park will transform this part of town.
items.cz: Ten nový park tuhle část města promění.
items.gap: The new park will ____ this part of town. (FORM)
accepts: The new park will transform this part of town.
items.explanation: **trans-** = change across: trans + form = change the form completely.
items.explanation_cz: **trans-** = změna napříč: trans + form = úplně změnit podobu.

items.en: Every card transaction costs the shop some money.
items.cz: Každá karetní transakce obchod něco stojí.
items.gap: Every card ____ costs the shop some money. (ACTION)
accepts: Every card transaction costs the shop some money.
items.explanation: **trans-** + action — money moves across, from card to shop.
items.explanation_cz: **trans-** + action — peníze jdou napříč, z karty do obchodu.

items.en: We took a non-stop flight to London.
items.cz: Vzali jsme si přímý let do Londýna.
items.gap: We took a ____ flight to London. (STOP)
accepts: We took a non-stop flight to London.
items.explanation: **non-** = not at all: non + stop = it never stops.
items.explanation_cz: **non-** = vůbec ne: non + stop = vůbec nestaví.

items.en: She works for a non-profit group in Prague.
items.cz: Pracuje pro neziskovou skupinu v Praze.
items.gap: She works for a ____ group in Prague. (PROFIT)
accepts: She works for a non-profit group in Prague.
items.explanation: **non-** + profit — the group does not work for money.
items.explanation_cz: **non-** + profit — skupina nepracuje pro peníze.

items.en: Many people joined the anti-war protest yesterday.
items.cz: Mnoho lidí se včera přidalo k protiválečnému protestu.
items.gap: Many people joined the ____ protest yesterday. (WAR)
accepts: Many people joined the anti-war protest yesterday.
items.explanation: **anti-** = against: anti + war = against the war.
items.explanation_cz: **anti-** = proti: anti + war = proti válce.

items.en: The co-pilot landed the plane with no problems.
items.cz: Ten druhý pilot přistál s letadlem bez problémů.
items.gap: The ____ landed the plane with no problems. (PILOT)
accepts: The co-pilot landed the plane with no problems.
items.explanation: **co-** = together: the co-pilot flies **with** the pilot.
items.explanation_cz: **co-** = spolu: co-pilot létá **s** pilotem.

items.en: We watched the film with English subtitles.
items.cz: Ten film jsme sledovali s anglickými titulky.
items.gap: We watched the film with English ____. (TITLE)
accepts: We watched the film with English subtitles.
items.explanation: **sub-** = under: the subtitles sit under the picture. Czech *titulky* is not English *titles*.
items.explanation_cz: **sub-** = pod: titulky jsou pod obrazem. České *titulky* nejsou anglické *titles*.

items.en: His ex-wife still lives in their old house.
items.cz: Jeho bývalá žena pořád bydlí v jejich starém domě.
items.gap: His ____ still lives in their old house. (WIFE)
accepts: His ex-wife still lives in their old house.
items.explanation: **ex-** = former: the marriage ended, the word keeps the hyphen.
items.explanation_cz: **ex-** = bývalý: manželství skončilo, slovo si nechává pomlčku.

items.en: He is an ex-member of the group now.
items.cz: Už je jen bývalým členem té skupiny.
items.gap: He is an ____ of the group now. (MEMBER)
accepts: He is an ex-member of the group now.
He's an ex-member of the group now.
items.explanation: **ex-member** = he was one before. A **non-member** never was one — different prefix, different story.
items.explanation_cz: **ex-member** = dřív jím byl. **Non-member** jím nikdy nebyl — jiná předpona, jiný příběh.

items.en: Stop talking nonsense and help me here.
items.cz: Přestaň mluvit nesmysly a pojď mi pomoct.
items.gap: Stop talking ____ and help me here. (SENSE)
accepts: Stop talking nonsense and help me here.
items.explanation: **non-** + sense — no sense at all. One word, no hyphen here.
items.explanation_cz: **non-** + sense — vůbec žádný smysl. Jedno slovo, bez pomlčky.

items.en: The intercity train to Brno leaves at seven.
items.cz: Ten meziměstský vlak do Brna jede v sedm.
items.gap: The ____ train to Brno leaves at seven. (CITY)
accepts: The intercity train to Brno leaves at seven.
items.explanation: **inter-** + city — the train runs between cities.
items.explanation_cz: **inter-** + city — vlak jezdí mezi městy.

items.en: He needed a heart transplant last year.
items.cz: Loni potřeboval transplantaci srdce.
items.gap: He needed a heart ____ last year. (PLANT)
accepts: He needed a heart transplant last year.
items.explanation: **trans-** + plant — the heart is moved across, into a new body.
items.explanation_cz: **trans-** + plant — srdce se přenáší do nového těla.

items.en: They lost the flat because of non-payment of rent.
items.cz: Přišli o byt kvůli neplacení nájmu.
items.gap: They lost the flat because of ____ of rent. (PAYMENT)
accepts: They lost the flat because of non-payment of rent.
items.explanation: **non-** + payment — the rent was not paid at all.
items.explanation_cz: **non-** + payment — nájem se vůbec neplatil.

items.en: Install a good antivirus program on your laptop.
items.cz: Nainstaluj si na notebook dobrý antivirový program.
items.gap: Install a good ____ program on your laptop. (VIRUS)
accepts: Install a good antivirus program on your laptop.
items.explanation: **anti-** + virus — it works against viruses. Czech *antivir* is missing the end.
items.explanation_cz: **anti-** + virus — pracuje proti virům. České *antivir* nemá konec slova.

items.en: A co-worker helped me finish the report.
items.cz: S tím reportem mi pomohl kolega.
items.gap: A ____ helped me finish the report. (WORKER)
accepts: A co-worker helped me finish the report.
items.explanation: **co-** + worker — you work together.
items.explanation_cz: **co-** + worker — pracujete spolu.

items.en: She was his co-star in two famous films.
items.cz: Hrála s ním hlavní roli ve dvou slavných filmech.
items.gap: She was his ____ in two famous films. (STAR)
accepts: She was his co-star in two famous films.
items.explanation: **co-** + star — two stars sharing the film.
items.explanation_cz: **co-** + star — dvě hvězdy v jednom filmu.

items.en: He is the co-author of this history book.
items.cz: Je spoluautorem téhle knihy o historii.
items.gap: He is the ____ of this history book. (AUTHOR)
accepts: He is the co-author of this history book.
He's the co-author of this history book.
items.explanation: **co-** + author — two people wrote it together.
items.explanation_cz: **co-** + author — napsali ji dva lidé spolu.

items.en: Take the subway from the airport to the centre.
items.cz: Z letiště do centra jeď metrem.
items.gap: Take the ____ from the airport to the centre. (WAY)
accepts: Take the subway from the airport to the centre.
items.explanation: **sub-** + way — a way under the ground.
items.explanation_cz: **sub-** + way — cesta pod zemí.

items.en: Her ex-husband picks the children up on Fridays.
items.cz: Její bývalý muž vyzvedává děti v pátek.
items.gap: Her ____ picks the children up on Fridays. (HUSBAND)
accepts: Her ex-husband picks the children up on Fridays.
items.explanation: **ex-** + husband — former, with a hyphen.
items.explanation_cz: **ex-** + husband — bývalý, s pomlčkou.

items.en: She saw her ex-boyfriend at the party yesterday.
items.cz: Včera na večírku viděla svého bývalého přítele.
items.gap: She saw her ____ at the party yesterday. (BOYFRIEND)
accepts: She saw her ex-boyfriend at the party yesterday.
items.explanation: **ex-** + boyfriend — it ended, the word says so.
items.explanation_cz: **ex-** + boyfriend — skončilo to a slovo to říká.

items.en: My ex-girlfriend moved to Germany last spring.
items.cz: Moje bývalá přítelkyně se loni na jaře přestěhovala do Německa.
items.gap: My ____ moved to Germany last spring. (GIRLFRIEND)
accepts: My ex-girlfriend moved to Germany last spring.
items.explanation: **ex-** + girlfriend — former.
items.explanation_cz: **ex-** + girlfriend — bývalá.

items.en: The ex-president still gives talks on television.
items.cz: Ten bývalý prezident pořád vystupuje v televizi.
items.gap: The ____ still gives talks on television. (PRESIDENT)
accepts: The ex-president still gives talks on television.
items.explanation: **ex-** + president — the role ended; the person continues.
items.explanation_cz: **ex-** + president — role skončila; člověk pokračuje.

items.en: Install a good antivirus program on your laptop.
items.cz: Nainstaluj si na notebook dobrý antivirový program.
items.wrong: Install a good antivir program on your laptop.
accepts: Install a good antivirus program on your laptop.
items.explanation: Czech *antivir* is half a word in English — **antivirus**.
items.explanation_cz: České *antivir* je v angličtině půlka slova — **antivirus**.

items.en: We watched the film with English subtitles.
items.cz: Ten film jsme sledovali s anglickými titulky.
items.wrong: We watched the film with English titles.
accepts: We watched the film with English subtitles.
items.explanation: *Titles* are names of books. Under the picture you read **subtitles**.
items.explanation_cz: *Titles* jsou názvy knih. Pod obrazem čteš **subtitles**.

items.en: We took a non-stop flight to London.
items.cz: Vzali jsme si přímý let do Londýna.
items.wrong: We took a no-stop flight to London.
accepts: We took a non-stop flight to London.
items.explanation: The prefix is **non-**, never *no-*: a **non-stop** flight.
items.explanation_cz: Předpona je **non-**, nikdy *no-*: **non-stop** let.

items.en: Take the subway from the airport to the centre.
items.cz: Z letiště do centra jeď metrem.
items.wrong: Take the underway from the airport to the centre.
accepts: Take the subway from the airport to the centre.
items.explanation: *Under-* from Prefixes 1 does not build this word — under the way is the **subway**.
items.explanation_cz: *Under-* z Předpon 1 tohle slovo nestaví — cesta pod zemí je **subway**.

items.en: The company works with international customers every day.
items.cz: Ta firma denně pracuje s mezinárodními zákazníky.
items.wrong: The company works with unnational customers every day.
accepts: The company works with international customers every day.
items.explanation: *Un-* makes an opposite. Between nations is **inter**national.
items.explanation_cz: *Un-* tvoří opak. Mezi národy je **inter**national.

items.en: A co-worker helped me finish the report.
items.cz: S tím reportem mi pomohl kolega.
items.wrong: A co-work helped me finish the report.
accepts: A co-worker helped me finish the report.
items.explanation: The person keeps the **-er**: co + work**er**.
items.explanation_cz: Osoba si nechává **-er**: co + work**er**.
